text: City Council on May 22, 23, and 24, 2018, in adopting Item EX34.20, has requested all City of Toronto agencies and corporations to: 1. Incorporate the City of Toronto's traditional Aboriginal land acknowledgement statement in their board meetings; and 2. Require their board members and staff to attend Indigenous Cultural Competency Training, developed by the City or comparable to the training provided by the City. The City Clerk's Office has prepared the attached guide on how to incorporate the land acknowledgements into board meetings. The guide reflects the best practices employed by City Council and its committees.
The Toronto Investment Board received the item for information.
